name: Banana Pancakes
desc: Fluffy griddle pancakes with two mashed ripe bananas in the batter.

source.title: Banana Pancakes I
source.evidence: All 8 ingredients and quantities match the page's recipeIngredient list; the page specifies white sugar.

ingredients.raw: 2 tbsp vegetable oil, plus more for the griddle

steps: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, mix the egg, milk, oil, and mashed bananas.
Stir the flour mixture into the banana mixture until no dry flour remains; the batter will be slightly lumpy.
Heat a griddle or large skillet over medium-high heat and brush it lightly with oil.

Pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top and the bottom is golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes, then flip and cook until the second side is golden and the center springs back, 2 to 3 minutes more. Serve hot.
tips: Makes about 12 pancakes. If the outsides brown before the centers set, turn the heat down to medium.

references.title: Banana Pancakes
references.usedFor: confirmed amounts, 1/4 cup per pancake, 3 to 5 minutes per side, yield of 12 pancakes
